definitions.explanation: Favoring traditional values, methods, or practices; resistant to change.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{保守的|ほしゅてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}をする。
examples.english: He has a conservative way of thinking.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{保守的|ほしゅてき}な{風土|ふうど}がある。
examples.english: This region has a conservative character.

examples.japanese: {保守的|ほしゅてき}な{見積|みつ}もりでも{100万円|ひゃくまんえん}はかかる。
examples.english: Even by conservative estimates, it will cost at least one million yen.
examples.notes: Uses the meaning 'cautious, on the safe side'

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {保守的|ほしゅてき}に (conservatively)
・Noun: {保守|ほしゅ} (conservatism, maintenance)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{保守的|ほしゅてき}な{考|かんが}え/{意見|いけん} (conservative thinking/opinion)
・{保守的|ほしゅてき}な{姿勢|しせい} (conservative stance)
・{保守的|ほしゅてき}な{見積|みつ}もり (conservative estimate)

USAGE: Can refer to:
・Political conservatism
・Traditional/unchanging attitudes
・Cautious or safe estimates

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{伝統的|でんとうてき}: Traditional (neutral, about customs)
・{保守的|ほしゅてき}: Conservative (implies resistance to change)
